purpose: Bounded competitive investigation before a local candidate, distinct from adoption or paid demand

repositories.name: zod
repositories.question: Find asynchronous parsing implementations and existing tests of asynchronous parsing.

repositories.name: trpc
repositories.question: Find server-side caller creation and existing tests for caller behavior.

repositories.name: hono
repositories.question: Find middleware composition and existing tests of next/error handling.

selection: Three public TypeScript codebases with tests and multiple packages or independently configured subprojects. Symbols selected from known public APIs before candidate implementation. No replacement for a setup failure.
controls: two worktrees with conflicting dirty symbol contents
broken index/cache cannot report authoritative empty references
offline_limits: Lookups are a small source-informed mechanical workload, not blind bug discoveries, agent task completion, token savings or human effort. Native search remains a legitimate alternative.

agent_stage.status: requires fresh explicit request budget and frozen held-out code-change tasks
agent_stage.comparison: same model, task inputs, permissions and limits; counterbalanced order; unchanged upstream acceptance tests
agent_stage.target: material end-to-end advantage, e.g. 20% median actual provider cost or elapsed time without observed loss of accepted task completion
agent_stage.limits: A small trial does not establish equivalence, significance, general savings or paid demand.

stop: Stop before candidate if no plausible repeated workflow advantage; stop after bounded candidate if held-out tasks do not show material benefit. No hosted platform before independent repeat use and paid commitment.
